notes.title: REACH THE LIGHT 1.0 is live!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone! REACH THE LIGHT 1.0 is live on Steam!!![/b]

The stage called "The Mountain" and the game Reach the light is finally complete, expect in the future some minor changes such as skins or decoration across this map. 
This stage marks the flow of the full game, but as many will know new content will be added in the future. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441429/9e7dbd0edf8da20bb779c6a0f1d0b9cea20aac63.png[/img]

Thank you for your amazing support and patience across the Early Access stage, you made this developer so happy :)


Remember to join the [url=https://discord.gg/ZTWnxk6ME2]Discord community[/url] if you haven't and 
 most importantly... [b]REACH THE LIGHT![/b]

See ya~

notes.title: Release date and more events!
notes.content:
Hello everyone REACH THE LIGHT will finally be released on October 25. Thank you so much for your support! But this is not everything for the future of the game.
See below the roadmap for REACH THE LIGHT. I'll be talking a little bit about each step:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441429/7e2d90514ff765df0198beda7ae14dff8b3019f4.png[/img]

[h3]►Release v1.0
[/h3]
This is the full version of the game, with more than ten challenges (including the mountain) and many skins!

[h3]►New Map: "The Lighthouse"
[/h3]
[i]There are more forms to reach the light... Face the high and desolate lighthouse
[/i]
A new map with the basic game mechanics, more platforms, more skins, and no checkpoints...

[h3]►New Map and New Mode?
[/h3]
[i]There is still another way to reach the light, for that it is necessary to change perspective.[/i]
Yes... Another map, skins, and a new way to play REACH THE LIGHT. I will announce the details soon!


And they are all free upgrades :)

Thank you for your support 
Remember to join the [url=https://discord.gg/ZTWnxk6ME2]Discord community[/url] [b]Early Access supporters can request unique skins![/b]

notes.title: Early Access 0.0.8 live!
notes.content:
[h1]A relatively big change[/h1]

[h2]About the platforms[/h2]
Now all platforms will work only if you are playing their particular section. Each time you find a new section, the previous platforms will turn off and the next one will turn on. 
This prevents the platforms from getting out of sync and ruining the level design.

[h2]Game changes[/h2]
Some sections have been modified to improve the game experience. Thanks for your feedback!

[h2]Twitch integration[/h2]
New NPCs appear in streamer mode to increase interaction with your chat. By simply approaching them, the chat will update itself.

[h2]Costumes[/h2]
The community has been participating and two new skins are available around the map. Will you be able to find them?
Check the Discord Community to know their locations!

[h2]Minor updates[/h2]
[list][*] Checkpoint visual effects[/list]
[list][*] 5 new songs[/list]
[list][*] 2 costume selectors[/list]
[list][*] New NPC lines[/list]

As always thank you for your support!

You can always check the [url=https://discord.gg/ZTWnxk6ME2]Discord community[/url] to send me direct feedback. [b]Players can suggest skins and their own npcs in the game just by participating on the server.[/b]

[i]Keep jumping, the light is closer![/i]

notes.title: Early Access 0.0.2 live!
notes.content:
[h1]New stuff![/h1]

[h2]"Booster" platform[/h2]
A new platform through the terrain is available to make it easier to navigate the additional hidden challenges.
[b]Bounce on them for a big jump and faster travel![/b]

[h2]Game changes[/h2]
The difficulty of the "pyramids" section has been reduced. Now it is a little more pleasant.

[h2]Minor fixes[/h2]
[list][*] Game progress on save slots[/list]
[list][*] Pause buttons alignment in some languages[/list]
[list][*] "Steel" skin sound volume fixed[/list]
[list][*] Load volume music at main menu[/list]
[list][*] SteamVR no longer starts at game startup[/list]

Thank you for your support. I am very happy with all the comments and the reception from you :)

You can always check the [url=https://discord.gg/ZTWnxk6ME2]Discord community[/url] to send me direct feedback. [b]Players can suggest skins and their own npcs in the game just by participating on the server[/b]... just saying!

Exciting stuff is coming in the next update... Some new skins, songs, and challenges!
[i]Keep jumping, the light is closer![/i]
